text: Give thanks to YHWH, for [He is] good, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
Give thanks to the God of gods, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
to the One doing great wonders by Himself alone, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
to the One making the heavens with understanding, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
to the One spreading out the earth upon the waters, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
to the One making great the lights—for His loving devotion [is] forever—
the sun for ruling over the day, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
the moon and stars for ruling over the night, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
to the one striking Egypt, against their firstborn, for His loving devotion [is] forever.
And He brought forth Israel from their midst, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
to the One dividing the Red sea into parts, for His loving devotion [is] forever.
And He made Israel pass through the midst of it, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
and He shook off Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
to the One leading His people through the wilderness, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
to the One striking great kings, for His loving devotion [is] forever.
And He killed mighty kings, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
Sihon king of the Amorite, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
and Og king of Bashan, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
and He gave their land as an inheritance—for His loving devotion [is] forever;
an inheritance to Israel His servant, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
who in our lowliness remembered us, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
and rescued us from our enemies, for His loving devotion [is] forever;
the One giving food to all flesh, for His loving devotion [is] forever.
Give thanks to the God of the heavens, for His loving devotion [is] forever!
